rundown: Eagles beat Cowboys 39-38 at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, TX. Eagles came back: they were down 28-10 at the half. The 4th quarter decided it: Eagles won it 22-7. Their win chance dropped as low as 1% along the way.
Scoring: Eagles 5 touchdowns and 2 field goals; Cowboys 5 touchdowns and 1 field goal. The last score: Jake Elliott 59 Yd Field Goal (4th quarter, 0:02).

Leading the way — Eagles: Joe Milton 21/31, 331 yds, 3 TD, 1 INT; Will Shipley 10 car, 46 yds; DeVonta Smith 11 rec, 200 yds, 2 TD. Cowboys: Dak Prescott 19/28, 291 yds, 2 TD, 1 INT; Javonte Williams 29 car, 101 yds, 2 TD; CeeDee Lamb 7 rec, 134 yds.

Against the closing line (DraftKings): Cowboys closed as 9.5-point favorites and lost outright to Eagles; Eagles won as the underdog at +391; the total closed at 49.5 and they combined for 77, over by 27.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 26, 4:27 PM ET. It had Eagles 24% and Cowboys 76%, projecting Eagles 21.5 – Cowboys 30.6 (52.1 total, Cowboys by 9.1).

Final: Eagles 39 – Cowboys 38. Wrong winner: it had Cowboys at 76%, and Eagles (24%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Eagles came in with a 15% below average attack and a league-average defense (3-7, 16.7 scored and 23.7 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 52 and 53 games of evidence. Projected to score 21.5, they scored 39 (+17.5 points, 81% over); projected to allow 30.6, they allowed 38 (+7.4 points, 24% over).

Cowboys came in with a 15% above average attack and a 10% leakier than average defense (5-6, 30.6 scored and 28.4 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 65 and 64 games of evidence. Projected to score 30.6, they scored 38 (+7.4 points, 24% over); projected to allow 21.5, they allowed 39 (+17.5 points, 81% over).

The bigger miss was Eagles' scoring (+17.5 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 77 against 52.1 projected (+24.9), about the 97th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±13.2).

Margin: Eagles by 1 against Cowboys by 9.1 projected, about the 22nd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12.8).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Cowboys ×1.02, Eagles ×1.00. It favored Cowboys, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Cowboys -8.5 → -9.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 40% of bets on Eagles, 39% of the money — Eagles covered; total: 8% of bets on the over, 8% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 14% of bets on Eagles, 14% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Cowboys, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.450 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -10.9 points. It counts toward NFL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 58 graded NFL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.991 and gives home teams -1 points. Team corrections so far: Eagles attack ×0.999, defense ×0.994 (3 games); Cowboys attack ×1.040, defense ×1.040 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
